integrity: Written global proof and separately replayable standard-library numerical diagnostics; finite tests are not universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic boundary claim for fixed Poisson target and free von-Mises concentration; does not assert finite-radius concentration uniqueness, other divergences, or optimality among all kernels. Historical originality is best-knowledge and not independently audited.
title: A sharp Cauchy–Gaussian boundary law for circular Poisson-to-von-Mises approximation
